title: The 1980s Pop Music Quiz
subtitle: Three rounds. Twenty seconds a question. Fastest fingers win.
notes: Written by claude-sonnet-5 for "1980s Pop Music". NOT YET REVIEWED — read every question in the editor before the gig.

questions.prompt: Which song gave The Human League the Christmas number one in 1981?
questions.answerNote: It topped the chart for five weeks over Christmas 1981.

questions.prompt: Which charity single was Christmas number one in the UK in 1984?
questions.answerNote: Band Aid's single famously kept Wham!'s "Last Christmas" stuck at number two.

questions.prompt: Which 1985 single was Madonna's first UK number one?
questions.answerNote: "Like a Virgin" only reached number three in the UK, so "Into the Groove" got there first.

questions.prompt: Which 1982 Michael Jackson album became the best-selling album of all time?
questions.answerNote: Thriller spawned seven top ten singles in the US and remains the biggest-selling album worldwide.

questions.prompt: Duran Duran formed in which English city in the late 1970s?
questions.answerNote: They started out playing at Birmingham's Rum Runner nightclub.

questions.prompt: Which Frankie Goes to Hollywood single spent nine weeks at UK number one in 1984?
questions.answerNote: "Two Tribes" held the top spot for nine weeks, while "Relax" only managed five.

questions.prompt: Which Norwegian band's "Take On Me" peaked at number two in the UK in 1985?
questions.answerNote: Despite huge global success, it was famously kept off the UK top spot.

questions.prompt: Eurythmics was a duo made up of Annie Lennox and which musician?
questions.answerNote: Dave Stewart co-wrote and produced most of Eurythmics' 1980s hits with Lennox.

questions.prompt: Which Spandau Ballet song topped the UK charts in 1983?
questions.answerNote: "Gold", released the same year, only made it to number two.

questions.prompt: Which duo scored a 1986 UK number one with "West End Girls"?
questions.answerNote: It became the Pet Shop Boys' breakthrough hit and a defining sound of mid-80s pop.
